proof:
Source: the change of scale used by Simon to obtain the scaled Deformation Theorem 5.3 from 5.1 ("obtained from the above by first changing scale x → ρ⁻¹x, then applying 5.1, then changing scale back by x → ρx", chapter-06.txt before 5.3), i.e. the push-forward 2.23 by the proper linear map x ↦ λx, with Remark 2.24(1) (∂ commutes with push-forward), the push-forward of integer multiplicity currents 3.3/3.9 for this injective linear map, and the scaling of Hausdorff measure. This is the tool of step 9 of the parent proof. Accepted DAG theorems named below (imrep_univ_smul_rescale_exists, imrep_smul_rescale_action_measure, dtc_hausdorff_dilation, dtc_approxTangent_dilation) are not siblings of this node: they may be reused as children if this node is decomposed; otherwise the arguments given here are formalized directly.

Notation. All currents and test forms are on univ in ℝ^P. For λ > 0 write δ_λ(x) := λx. For a k-form ω let (δ_λ^#ω)(x) := ω(λx) ∘ (λ·id) (pull-back, Simon 6.1.13), i.e. (δ_λ^#ω)(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ω(λx)(λv_1, …, λv_k) = λ^k ω(λx)(v_1, …, v_k); so δ_λ^#ω = λ^k ω(λ·) (as a covector-valued map, λ^k • ω(λ • x)). |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm.

1. Pull-back facts. Let λ > 0 and ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P).
 (a) δ_λ^#ω is C^∞ with tsupport δ_λ^#ω = λ⁻¹·tsupport ω (compact), so it is a test form; δ_λ^#(ω − ω') = δ_λ^#ω − δ_λ^#ω'.
 (b) If ω_j → ω in 𝒟^k (supports in a fixed compact K, all derivatives converging uniformly), then δ_λ^#ω_j → δ_λ^#ω (supports in λ⁻¹K; the r-th derivative of δ_λ^#ω is λ^{k+r} times the r-th derivative of ω at λx).
 (c) d(δ_λ^#ω) = δ_λ^#(dω) (naturality of d under the linear map δ_λ; SimonGMT exteriorDerivative_affinePullbackForm with L = λ·id and b = 0).
 (d) δ_λ^#(δ_{λ⁻¹}^#ω) = ω, since λ^kλ^{−k}ω(λ⁻¹λx) = ω(x).
 (e) |δ_λ^#ω(x)| = λ^k|ω(λx)|.

2. Definition. For k ∈ ℕ, λ > 0 and X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) put dil k λ X (ω) := X(δ_λ^#ω); for λ ≤ 0 put dil k λ X := X (irrelevant). By 1(a) dil k λ X is linear in ω and by 1(b) sequentially continuous, so dil k λ X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P). (It is the push-forward δ_{λ#}X of 2.23; it can also be obtained from SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn.affinePushforward with L = λ·id, b = 0.) Fix λ > 0 and k.

3. Algebra. (sub) dil k λ (X − Y)(ω) = X(δ_λ^#ω) − Y(δ_λ^#ω) = (dil k λ X − dil k λ Y)(ω). (inverse) dil k λ⁻¹ (dil k λ X)(ω) = X(δ_λ^#δ_{λ⁻¹}^#ω) = X(ω) by 1(d). (boundary) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}: (dil (k+1) λ X).boundary(ω) = X(δ_λ^#(dω)) = X(d(δ_λ^#ω)) = X.boundary(δ_λ^#ω) = dil k λ (X.boundary)(ω) by 1(c). Currents with equal values on all test forms are equal (GeometricCurrentOn.ext).

4. Vanishing and the explicit action. If X vanishes off E and tsupport ω is disjoint from λE = δ_λ(E), then tsupport δ_λ^#ω = λ⁻¹tsupport ω is disjoint from E, so dil k λ X (ω) = X(δ_λ^#ω) = 0. For every ω, η := δ_λ^#ω is a test form with η(x) = λ^k • ω(λ • x) and dil k λ X (ω) = X(η).

5. Mass. ω ↦ λ^{−k}δ_λ^#ω is a bijection of the set of admissible forms {ω : |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x} (on univ, tsupport ⊆ univ is automatic) onto itself, with inverse η ↦ λ^kδ_{λ⁻¹}^#η, by 1(d), (e). Hence M(dil k λ X) = sup_ω ENNReal.ofReal(X(δ_λ^#ω)) = sup_η ENNReal.ofReal(λ^k X(η)) = ENNReal.ofReal(λ^k)·sup_η ENNReal.ofReal(X(η)) = ENNReal.ofReal(λ^k)·M(X) (ENNReal.ofReal(ab) = ENNReal.ofReal(a)ENNReal.ofReal(b) for a ≥ 0, and multiplication by a finite constant commutes with suprema in [0, ∞]).

6. Integrality (Simon 3.3/3.9 for the linear isomorphism δ_λ). Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in univ representing X. Define R' := (λM, θ(λ⁻¹·), ξ(λ⁻¹·)). It is an IMRep: λM is Borel (image under a homeomorphism); it is countably k-rectifiable (compose the Lipschitz parametrizations with δ_λ; images of Hᵏ-null sets are null); θ(λ⁻¹·) is Borel, positive on λM; Hᵏ(δ_λ(A)) = λ^kHᵏ(A) for all A (scaling of Hausdorff measure: Mathlib MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure_smul₀, and μHE[k] is a constant multiple of μH[k]), which gives local integrability on compact sets; ξ(λ⁻¹·) is measurable; and the approximate tangent space of λM at λx equals that of M at x (blowUpMap (λx) r '' (λM) = blowUpMap x (r/λ) '' M, so the defining limits coincide), which ξ(x) orients. Its action: by the change of variables y = λx (Hᵏ⌞(λM) is the image of λ^kHᵏ⌞M),
 R'.action(ω) = ∫_{λM} θ(λ⁻¹y)ξ(λ⁻¹y)(ω(y)) dHᵏ(y) = λ^k∫_M θ(x)ξ(x)(ω(λx)) dHᵏ(x) = ∫_M θξ(δ_λ^#ω) dHᵏ = X(δ_λ^#ω) = dil k λ X (ω).
 So dil k λ X is IM. (This is exactly the content of the accepted DAG theorems imrep_univ_smul_rescale_exists and imrep_smul_rescale_action_measure with c := λ⁻¹, and of dtc_approxTangent_dilation for the tangent spaces.)

7. Change of variables for Hᵏ. By the scaling in 6, the image measure of μHE[k] under δ_λ is λ^{−k}μHE[k] (for Borel B, μHE[k](δ_λ⁻¹(B)) = μHE[k](λ⁻¹B) = λ^{−k}μHE[k](B)); equivalently μHE[k] = map δ_λ (λ^kμHE[k]). δ_λ is a measurable equivalence, so for every A ⊆ ℝ^P (restriction commutes with the image under a measurable equivalence: Mathlib MeasurableEquiv.restrict_map) and every g : ℝ^P → ℝ (Mathlib MeasureTheory.integral_map_equiv, valid for arbitrary g),
 ∫_{δ_λ(A)} g dHᵏ = ∫ g d(map δ_λ ((λ^kμHE[k]).restrict A)) = λ^k∫_A g(λx) dHᵏ(x).
 (The accepted DAG theorem dtc_hausdorff_dilation states the same measure identity for the map y ↦ λ⁻¹y.)

8. Conclusion. The operation dil of step 2 satisfies, for every k and λ > 0, the eight clauses of the statement: (sub), (inverse), (mass) by 3 and 5; (IM) by 6; (boundary) by 3; (vanishing) and the explicit action by 4; the change of variables by 7. ∎
key_steps: δ_λ^#ω = λ^kω(λ·) is a test form, continuous in ω, commutes with d, and δ_λ^#δ_{λ⁻¹}^# = id.
dil_k(λ, X)(ω) := X(δ_λ^#ω); subtraction, inversion, ∂-commutation, vanishing and the explicit action are immediate.
Mass: ω ↦ λ^{−k}δ_λ^#ω is a bijection of admissible forms, so M scales by λ^k.
IM: (λM, θ(λ⁻¹·), ξ(λ⁻¹·)) is an IMRep representing dil_k(λ, X) (Hᵏ scales by λ^k, approximate tangent spaces are dilation invariant).
Change of variables: map δ_λ μHE[k] = λ^{−k}μHE[k] and δ_λ is a measurable equivalence.
